decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system is close to the firm's office-interior and configurable-product knowledge, so management is likely to keep it and learn further despite the added technical complexity of adjustability.
A chair family fits the firm's core capabilities in seating, craftsmanship, design collaboration, and quality testing, making it a strong candidate to retain and refine.
Floor cushions made from carpets are a more peripheral niche to the firm's main furniture know-how, so absorptive capacity for improving and scaling them is weaker than for its core products.
A soft upholstered sofa builds directly on the firm's established lounge and living-space expertise, giving management confidence that design learning can be translated into commercial improvements.
The high standing table is well aligned with the firm's office and conference solutions and with demand for flexible workplaces, so it is likely to remain in the range.

Although rugs are somewhat adjacent to furniture, this collection was positioned as a flagship direction and draws on the firm's material expertise and integrated interior concept, which supports continued commitment.
